scenes.title: WHAT IF GOD IS STILL WORKING?
scenes.body: Even when you cannot see it.

scenes.title: SILENCE DOES NOT MEAN ABSENCE
scenes.body: Faith keeps standing before the answer arrives.

scenes.title: GOD HAS NOT LOST YOUR ADDRESS
scenes.body: Bring the fear, the delay and the questions back to Him.

scenes.title: I CAN DO ALL THINGS THROUGH CHRIST
DO NOT QUIT IN THE MIDDLE OF THE STORY
scenes.body: The chapter you are in is not the whole testimony.

scenes.title: PRAY. BELIEVE. MOVE.
scenes.body: Choose one faithful step and take it with Jesus.

scenes.title: YOUR HOPE HAS A NAME: JESUS
scenes.body: Let His Word be louder than the fear.

scenes.title: ONE MILLION SOULS
scenes.body: Share this with someone who needs hope today.
